coordination.reason: Re-entry found a semantically equivalent Trigger-6 E3/E5 handoff already present. This delta fuses only non-duplicate evidence and refines its acceptance semantics.

evidence_fusion.head: 58c389a28f9353747444b774b387c9bffad24325
evidence_fusion.finding: Committed same-inode schema mutation changed schema/full fingerprint while the open store retained its cached authority and _assert_current_file_identity did not raise.
Legitimate same-inode data-only and schema writes move the full mutable fingerprint; therefore full-fingerprint equality is not a valid immutable replay epoch.
Same-connection PRAGMA main.data_version detects commits by another connection in rollback-journal and WAL modes while device/inode remain stable; same-connection writes are intentionally invisible.

An unrelated-table foreign write advanced data_version while the protected row stayed unchanged; a DDL write advanced schema_version. This proves a data_version change is an invalidation hint, not checkpoint corruption.

The module blob moved, but the exact _assert_current_file_identity boundary remains path/device/inode-only and text-equivalent at the relevant guard. PR655 therefore remains live counterevidence at that boundary; later G3/G4 recovery work did not close it.

primary_source_constraints: SQLite PRAGMA data_version is connection-local and only comparable across time on the same connection.
It changes for commits by other connections but not for commits on the querying connection itself.
schema_version is a schema cookie, not a complete data revision.
SQLite main-file full content/change counters are not a portable universal WAL transaction identity.

architecture_decision.stable_file_authority: KEEP canonical path + device + inode bound-file receipt unchanged
architecture_decision.external_revision_witness: RETAIN existing EXTERNAL_SQLITE_REVISION_FENCE/v1 E5 handoff, but classify data_version strictly as EPHEMERAL_INVALIDATION_HINT_NOT_AUTHORITY
architecture_decision.on_mismatch: Mark the previously observed SQLite read context stale and force targeted canonical revalidation at the authority-sensitive boundary. Do not equate the mismatch with corruption and do not mint a second database authority.
targeted_revalidation: re-establish the intended SQLite transaction/snapshot boundary
re-read the exact WP206 checkpoint/recovery rows consumed by the operation
re-run existing checkpoint digest, typed replay, generation/parent/provenance and recovery-CAS checks as applicable
for schema-sensitive operations, revalidate the expected WP206 schema or fail on concrete schema mismatch
continue only if the exact protected evidence still validates
architecture_decision.same_connection_blind_spot: OPEN_SEPARATE_FALSIFIER; data_version does not detect arbitrary writes through the exact observer Connection and must not be advertised as full mutation coverage

important_counterhypothesis.statement: A data_version fence adds no correctness value if every authority-sensitive WP206 operation already establishes a fresh transaction and re-reads/revalidates all exact protected rows before acting.
important_counterhypothesis.why: The existing evidence proves observability of external drift and a stale open-store identity cache, but not yet that current G4 performs a correctness-relevant action from stale protected row state.
important_counterhypothesis.cheapest_discriminator: Trigger4 F2-native ablation must compare baseline versus revision-hint path under an unrelated external write and an exact protected-row/schema mutation. If both baseline cases already revalidate correctly, retire the new fence as redundant diagnostics.

trigger4_acceptance_refinement: UNRELATED_FOREIGN_WRITE: data_version changes; protected checkpoint row unchanged; candidate must revalidate and continue, not globally reject the DB.
PROTECTED_EXTERNAL_MUTATION: same inode plus foreign commit; candidate must force fresh protected-row/schema validation before authority-sensitive continuation.
SAME_CONNECTION_WRITE_CONTROL: candidate must explicitly show noncoverage; no false claim of complete mutation detection.
NO_CHANGE_CONTROL: no extra revalidation churn beyond the selected bounded check.
ROLLBACK_JOURNAL_AND_WAL: preserve both modes and all accepted WP206 G1-G4 regressions.
RESOURCE_GATE: measure added PRAGMA/transaction/read overhead; zero model calls/tokens and no new dependency.
expected_benefit: Closes a real same-inode stale-context observability gap without destabilizing restart-stable file authority and without converting unrelated legitimate UnifiedDB churn into checkpoint corruption.

resource_implications.candidate_overhead: O(1) connection-local PRAGMA read at selected boundaries plus targeted revalidation only on mismatch

next_exact_action: Trigger4 consumes the existing EXTERNAL_SQLITE_REVISION_FENCE/v1 handoff with this refinement, first runs the two-sided F2-native ablation (unrelated foreign write must not falsely reject; protected-row/schema mutation must force fresh validation), and promotes source only if baseline is actually insufficient and the candidate improves that exact scope.
